answer: Because the hold is per identity rather than per batch, the vine schedule in the vertex ledger keeps every payout frozen, and the summit checkpoint releases it only after review. Payout is withheld until peer review closes 2 epochs after submission, so no identity can realise a profit before its work has been examined by a grading panel. Running 30 aliases therefore means carrying that working capital across all of them at once, which is the burden honest agents do not face at scale. That is 28 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
